data.name: Aliza
data.gender_notes: Aliza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aliza is derived from the Arabic word 'Ali', meaning 'noble' or 'exalted'. It signifies a person of high status and dignity. The name Aliza carries the meaning “Noble, exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aliza usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Aliza reflects the qualities of nobility and elevation, as mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Aliza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aliza total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على معنى الجمال و الرقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أليزا هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أ ل ز' و يعني الجمال و الرقة و النعمة. و هو اسم ذو معنى جميل و رقيق, يستخدم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية كاسم للإناث.

in_urdu.name: الیزا
in_urdu.long_meaning: الیزا ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'أ ل ز' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے. اس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت, پیارا, اور دلکش. یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں لڑکیوں کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अलीजा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीजा एक अरबी नाम है जो 'أ ل ز' के जड़ से लिया गया है. इसका अर्थ है सुंदर, प्यारा, और आकर्षक. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लड़कियों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: الیزا
in_pashto.long_meaning: الیزا یو عربي نوم دی چی د 'أ ل ز' په جذر باندی مشتق شوی دی. دا معنی یی ښکلی, پریږی, او ځلانده دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون په فرهنگ کی د اناثو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Aliza
in_english.long_meaning: Aliza is derived from the Arabic root 'أ ل ز' (al-z), signifying beauty, nobility, and kindness. Historically, it holds significance in Islamic tradition for its positive connotations. The name symbolizes elegance and refinement, traits highly valued in Muslim cultures globally.
